input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, apply it across the Agreement, add standard uncapped carve-outs and preserve Client's payment obligations outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, so we have added Client to the cap rather than leaving our exposure unlimited while TrueLink's is limited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data-security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap for both parties, and Client's payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
